# neo4jaura_projects (Data Source)

Aura Projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "neo4jaura_projects" "this" {}

output "projects" {
  value = data.neo4jaura_projects.this.projects
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) When set, fetches only projects belonging to this organization.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the projects data source
- `projects` (Attributes List) The list of all available projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `projects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project.
